title: Patch window ops briefing and caffeine checklist - Mar 2025
content:
Purpose:
To scope a 3-hour patch window for small infra and runtime fixes that is low-risk but requires operator care. This doc doubles as the operator brief, the high-level rollout calendar, and a slightly ridiculous caffeine checklist (because humans). Use this as the quick handoff for on-call + release steward.

TL;DR:
- Window: 2025-03-18 02:00-05:00 UTC (quietest traffic slice across NA/EU).
- Primary steward: Dana Kim. Ops lead backup: Elliot Song. SRE pager: Priya Narang.
- Target: deploy runtime hotfix v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3 (small kernel selector tweak + kv-cache bugfix).
- Goal: zero-customer-impact, sub-150ms p50 tail latency, no data plane restarts.

Pre-window (72h, 24h, 1h checkpoints):
- 72h: code PR merged + CI green, canary plan registered (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/417).
- 24h: smoke cluster deploy successful (deploy tag: patch/2025-03-18-ksel). Log retention snapshot taken.
- 1h: verify canary traffic shaping rule ready, alert routing configured, Slack watch channel pinned (#release-ops).

Operator quick checklist (pre-deploy):
- [ ] Confirm reserved maintenance capacity (dedicated pool asleep -> warmed). Owner: Marcus Lee.
- [ ] Snapshot KV cache meta for canary group. Command: ops/cache-snapshot --env=staging --tag=prepatch-20250318
- [ ] Toggle sticky routing OFF for test customer lanes. Ticket: JIRA-1342.
- [ ] Ensure rollout runbook open in browser + have smoke test terminal ready.
- [ ] Verify rollout abort command works: ops/rollout abort --id=patch-2025-03-18

Caffeine & human-care checklist (yes, put this in the brief):
- Coffee station mapped: 2x Nespresso pods + one thermos of tea in Ops war room.
- Snack stash: granola bars + electrolyte sachets (location: ops-kitchen shelf B).
- Quiet signal: if lead issues an audible double-bell -> 10 minute full focus (no background tasks).
- Rotate microphone owner every 45 minutes (prevents voice fatigue).

Rollout calendar (hour-by-hour):
- 02:00 UTC: gate open, short briefing (5m). Confirm monitoring graphs up.
- 02:05 UTC: deploy canary to 2% traffic (tag: canary-02-05). Observe 10m.
- 02:15 UTC: health check and latency smoke (p50/p95), quick log sanity scan.
- 02:30 UTC: if stable, move to 10% traffic. Observe 15m.
- 02:50 UTC: run sample regression prompts (prompt-suite: smoke/basic-latency.json).
- 03:10 UTC: expand to 35% (if thresholds met).
- 03:35 UTC: full cluster rollout (gradual ramp), with 5m pause after each node-subgroup.
- 04:30 UTC: stabilization period and customer-facing check (sample requests to canary traces).
- 05:00 UTC: window close, write short release note + tag release channel.

Smoke tests (copyable commands):
- smoke/generate-test --model=rwd-llama-13b --len=64 --replicate=50
- smoke/payload-assert --p95-latency<1200ms --error-rate<0.5%
- smoke/kv-validate --warmup=10 --verify-prefixes

Telemetry anchors and alert thresholds (operator must verify before opening window):
- Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 850ms (if p95 crosses 1.2s for >3m abort).
- Errors: 5xx rate < 0.5% (if >1% sustained >2m, rollback).
- CPU/GPU: node GPU memory < 86% (if >92% on two nodes, throttle routing).
- Queue depth: request queue per node < 120 (if >220, slow-rollback).
Notes: we will temporarily increase sampling for traces and token-level breakdown in Console for the 3-hour window.

Rollback triggers (explicit):
- Canary error-rate >1% for 5m OR p95 > 1.5s for 3m.
- Any customer-visible 5xx spike correlated via request-id tracing.
- Scheduled cascade: if two unrelated host restarts within 10m after rollout step.
Rollback steps:
1) Run ops/rollout abort --id=patch-2025-03-18 OR ops/rollforward rollback --to-tag=stable-1.3.2
2) Disable autoscaler for the affected pool (prevents noisy reboots).
3) Rehydrate prepatch KV snapshot as needed.
4) Open incident channel and escalate to SRE manager if unresolved after 20m.

Post-window (notes to draft for release notes):
- Draft headline: "runtime: small kernel-selector fix and kv-cache stability improvements (v1.3.3)"
- Body (short): "Rolled out v1.3.3 to production during the March 18 patch window. Fixes include a deterministic kernel selector fallback that addresses a rare mismatched-kernel path and several robustness improvements to KV prefix caching. No customer-impacting errors were observed in the 3 hour window; we observed an expected ~0.4% reduction in token CPU usage on average in canary traffic.
Known followups: performance variance observed on r4-gpu nodes in eu-west-1 (tracking JIRA-1360)."

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Can we add a preflight script to auto-validate the rollback command accessibility? (low-hanging)
- Should we instrument an additional synthetic that targets long-turn chats (seq>1024) for the next patch window?
- Check legal/compliance stake: any customer with pinned models in private deployments affected? Ping privacy-compliance if yes.

Hand-off checklist (closing minutes):
- [ ] Publish short release note to #release-notes with link to full runbook.
- [ ] Confirm metrics snapshot saved (ops/metrics-snap --tag=postpatch-20250318).
- [ ] Create short retro notes in Confluence with time-stamped anomalies.

Quick references (for operators):
- Abort alias: ops abort-patch patch-2025-03-18
- Canary logs: logs/query?tag=canary-02-05 (Console link pinned in Slack).
- Contact list: Dana Kim (lead), Elliot Song (ops), Priya Narang (SRE), Marcus Lee (capacity).

— end of brief —

Notes: keep this doc intentionally compact. For full runbook and playbooks reference Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Patch+Window+Guidelines. This draft will be expanded into the canonical runbook if the patch pattern repeats more than twice in a quarter.

Quick version history:
- 2025-03-05: initial sketch and schedule proposal.
- 2025-03-06: telemetry anchors tightened after SRE review.
- 2025-03-07: added caffeine checklist and snack stash location per ops request.
